assumptions: Token counts are planning assumptions, not observed measurements.
Scenarios assume one model request per ticket and zero retries.
Excludes hosting, database, networking, taxes, and operational labor.

limitations: Synthetic set is small and is a development baseline, not production evidence.
Mock-provider evaluation has no observed model token usage; model latency measures local mock execution only.
Groundedness is reported only for human-adjudicated claims whose draft hash matches this run.
